I started takibyte as a place to document my path into cybersecurity, most of this is for my own learning and reference. If it's useful to someone else going through similar homelab experiments, CTF rooms, and certs, that's a bonus and would make me happy!

Most of the projects and logs that end up here start as a homelab experiment, a TryHackMe room/CTF challenge, or a concept from studying that I thought might be useful to write about.

You can read more about my plan and roadmap in: My path to cybersecurity.

If you want to see more, you can find my links below.
